messages.author: 487aae5e13177aff
messages.subject: about the tileMethylCounts() function
parts:
Hi Altuna,

I wondered if there is a way to output the number of bases that are covered in each window when using the function tileMethylCounts()? In most cases, the differential methylated windows with several covered bases are more reliable than those with only one base, so having this information in the output is sometimes desirable.

Thank you very much!

Best,
Li

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] about the tileMethylCounts() function
parts:
Hi Li,
It is calculated internally but not output in the object. if you want to know how many CpGs they overlap, you need to use countOverlaps() function as follows:

library(GenomicRanges)
olaps=countOverlaps( as(tiled.methylBase.obj,"GRanges"), as(methylBase.obj,"GRanges") )
